summary: Planban 2.0.1 makes taking large and older boards online more reliable, helps agents keep cards up to date, and lets agents complete a card or change goals when you agree in chat.
updatePrompt: Update Planban from planban-ai/planban. Verify version 2.0.1, the installed plugin, and MCP tools; open an existing Board and confirm it remains readable and writable. Dependencies are unchanged from 2.0.0. Reinstall the plugin after refreshing the marketplace so cached skills, hook scripts, and MCP instructions are updated, then start a new session. Nothing goes online unless the person takes a board online.
changelogSummary: More reliable Take Online for large and older boards, clearer rules and warnings that keep cards current, and agents that act on what you agree in chat.
